security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A small desktop widget for daily tasks, coins, streaks and rewards.
bundle.longDescription: Task Widget keeps today's tasks in the corner of your screen. Finish tasks to earn coins and XP, keep a streak, level up, and spend coins on rewards you choose. Works offline; data stays on your PC.
